[BeefCake Pulse manual > Signal drops or keeps disconnecting]
If your heart rate drops out or the Pulse keeps disconnecting, wet the electrode pads again and tighten the strap. Keep the device it's paired with within 2 meters. The Pulse connects to one device at a time, so disconnect it from the Row before using it with your phone. A weak battery also causes the signal to drop, so replace the battery if the problem continues.

[BeefCake Bell manual > About the Bell]
The BeefCake Bell is an adjustable kettlebell from 4 kg to 32 kg in 2 kg steps. It sits in a base cradle, and you change the weight with the dial on top of the handle. The Bell connects to the BeefCake Coach app over Bluetooth to count reps and track weight.

[BeefCake Bell manual > Changing the weight]
Set the Bell fully in its base cradle on a flat floor. The dial only turns when the Bell is seated in the cradle. Turn the dial until it clicks at the weight you want, then lift the Bell straight up. The plates you're not using stay in the cradle.

user_query: how long is the warranty on the rower?

results:
[BeefCake policies > Warranty]
The BeefCake Row and the BeefCake Bell have a 2-year warranty. The BeefCake Pulse has a 1-year warranty. The warranty starts on the delivery date and covers defects in materials and workmanship. It doesn't cover normal wear, damage from misuse, or water damage. The warranty covers the original purchaser only and can't be transferred. To make a warranty claim, contact BeefCake Support with your serial number.

[BeefCake Coach app help > Getting help]
Contact BeefCake Support from the Coach app under Profile > Help. Our support team can look up orders, start returns, and check warranty status.

[BeefCake policies > Damaged deliveries]
If your order arrives damaged, contact BeefCake Support within 7 days of delivery with photos of the damage. We'll send a replacement or a prepaid return label. Damage reported after 7 days is handled as a warranty claim.
